seo.title: About Brother Femi - My Story & Vision
seo.description: Learn about my spiritual journey, vision, mission, core values, and heart cry as a bond servant of Christ.

content.title: My Journey to Faith
content.description: On the 22nd of June 2025, at HOWJ Atlanta I had a life-changing encounter with the Lord Jesus Christ. It was a moment of divine personal conviction, revelation and transformation that set me on a new path of faith and purpose - I had a strong nudge in my soul to search God afresh at all cost. Since then, I have been committed to living as a bond servant of Christ, seeking to know Him more deeply and to reflect His love and grace in all aspects of my life.
content.paragraph2: This website is a faith-inspired space to share my journey, connect with fellow believers, and encourage a Christ-centered life of love, humility, and purpose.
content.paragraph3: I look forward to hearing from you, sharing insights, and growing together in faith. May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you always.

content.title: New Life in Christ
content.bibleVerse: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.

sections.title: What is a Christian?
sections.content: A Christian is someone who believes in and follows Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior.

subsections.title: Core Beliefs
items: Jesus is the Son of God, who lived a sinless life, died for our sins, & rose again (1 Corinthians 15:3–4).
Salvation is by grace through faith, not earned by good works (Ephesians 2:8–9).
The Bible is God's inspired Word, the foundation for belief and practice (2 Timothy 3:16).
Christians strive to live like Jesus, loving God and loving others (Matthew 22:37–39).

subsections.title: In Practice
items: A Christian has a personal relationship with God through Jesus.
They repent of sin, trust in Christ's sacrifice, and walk in obedience.
They become part of the body of Christ, the global family of believers.

subsections.title: Simply Put
subsections.description: A Christian is a forgiven sinner, made new by Christ, and committed to following Him.

sections.title: Spiritual Warfare
sections.description: The Christian life involves spiritual warfare, as believers stand firm against spiritual opposition and rely on God's strength for victory.
sections.content: Spiritual warfare is the ongoing battle between good and evil, light and darkness, in the life of every believer. It is not fought with physical weapons, but with faith, prayer, and the Word of God (Ephesians 6:10–18). Believers are called to stand firm, put on the full armor of God, and resist the schemes of the enemy. Victory is found in Christ, who has already overcome the world (John 16:33). Stay alert, pray continually, and trust in God's power to protect and deliver you.

content.title: Spiritual Mentors & Teachers

content.title: 15 Life Principles to Live By
content.description: Timeless principles for navigating life with wisdom, faith, and purpose.

principles.text: Our intimacy with God—His highest priority for our lives—determines the impact of our lives.
Obey God and leave all the consequences to Him.
God's Word is an immovable anchor in times of storm.
The awareness of God's presence energizes us for our work.
God does not require us to understand His will, just obey it, even if it seems unreasonable.
You reap what you sow, more than you sow, and later than you sow.
The dark moments of our life will last only so long as is necessary for God to accomplish His purpose in us.
Fight all your battles on your knees and you win every time.
Trusting God means looking beyond what we can see to what God sees.
If necessary, God will move heaven and earth to show us His will.
God assumes full responsibility for our needs when we obey Him.
Peace with God is the fruit of oneness with God.
Listening to God is essential to walking with God.
God acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
Brokenness is God's requirement for maximum usefulness.
